verdict.rationale: Vanta is a compliance platform with its own AI Agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only Vanta acting as an MCP server, either for its API or for its developer docs, that external assistants like Claude or Cursor connect to. That is the opposite role. Nothing shows Vanta or its AI Agent connecting to user-supplied MCP servers or using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
